If a valid circle encloses exactly one actual native spectral value, the ACTUAL range is its ENTIRE algebraic root space even for a multiple root. Every projected native domain vector is an actual scalar multiple of that eigenfunction INSIDE H1, and the ACTUAL projected residual has factor nu*(mu-lambda).

ALL ordinary physical L2([0,1],C) data are included by a bounded COMPLEX LINEAR map into the FULL native dual. This agrees EXACTLY with the original domain inclusion on EVERY zero-trace H1 vector and is proved INJECTIVE: a dual annihilator would force all L2 Fourier coefficients to be the same constant, which finite-exponent decay excludes unless they vanish.

The actual Dirichlet projection on the FULL ordinary physical L2 interval space is constructed by the SAME H1-valued contour lift. At a simple isolated actual eigenvalue its FULL L2 range is precisely the normalized native eigenfunction line.

For EVERY physical L2 datum the ACTUAL scalar projection amplitude exists; its norm is bounded by the ACTUAL L2 projection operator norm times the datum norm. This is an exact operator bound, not an unproved o(1) comparison with the free projection.
